_comment: Companions fighting beside the protagonist (scripts/npc/ally.gd), per NPC id. Seconds, metres, hit points. downed: health reaching 0 knocks them down (never dead in ordinary combat); the protagonist helps them up within help_range, or they get up alone after recover_calm seconds with no enemy within calm_range. follow_side / follow_back: where he walks, in the camera's frame (beside and slightly behind, never in view); follow_slack: how far off that spot before he moves.
